items.title: If You Invest $7,500 Into These 3 Stocks, You Could Have $15,000 by 2030
items.summary: CrowdStrike, Palantir and Cloudflare all posted record quarters, yet one of them does most of the heavy lifting in this basket. A five-year model tests whether a $7,500 stake can truly double, and which scenario it demands.
